name: Anyscale Pricing - Pay-as-you-go GPU rates (Hosted tier)
notes: Fetched 2026-10-04. Published pricing page, Hosted tier, pay-as-you-go. Two billing models: Hosted (Anyscale-managed) and BYOC (bring your own cloud). $100 free credit to start. Published per-hour rates: CPU Only $0.0135/hr; NVIDIA T4 $0.5682/hr; NVIDIA L4 $0.9542/hr; NVIDIA A10G $1.3635/hr; NVIDIA A100 $4.9591/hr. H/B/GB GPU families all 'Contact Us' - no published rate for H100/H200/B200. Usage-based billing with no monthly fixed fees; committed contracts unlock volume discounts. BYOC deploys on AWS, Azure, GCP, CoreWeave or on-prem/K8s. Case studies claim 50-99% savings vs alternatives.
